power.method: 115/230 VAC (50/60 Hz) or 24 VAC, 50 W with heaters

features: day (color) / night (mono) switchover, auto or manual
RS-422 / RS-232 / RS-485 serial control (non-proprietary Cohu standard)
release_notes: The Cohu 3950 iVIEW is an outdoor analog PTZ camera/positioner system with a 1/4-inch CCD, 23x optical zoom, day/night switchover, and 360-degree continuous pan in a dry-nitrogen-pressurized IP67/NEMA 4X housing. Analog composite output with RS-422/232/485 serial PTZ control; no IP/ONVIF/RTSP.
